Chapter 290: Chapter 3: Oh no, am I going to be surpassed by my disciple? (Please subscribe)

Chikun Star Lord’s gaze swept across the ‘model’ in Lin Yuan’s hand, made up of various forces of space.

Space rules, vast and endless, have no concrete shape, it’s very difficult for ordinary Evolvers to comprehend space.

Space is not like flame, which can emit heat and be felt, nor like earth, which can be touched.

Therefore—

In the six hundred thousandth year of the Starry Sea Era, a powerful Evolver from the Human Civilization Alliance, skilled in the Dao of space, based on his understanding, substituted the superficial essence of space rules with nine hundred sixty-five models.

These nine hundred sixty-five models, far from expressing the true space rules, could nevertheless point other Evolvers in the right direction.

...

They had an effect similar to ‘formulas.’

Normally, to fully understand these nine hundred sixty-five space models was basically equivalent to an introduction to the space rules.

And to achieve this, one basically needed to be Seventh Rank.

After all, only Seventh Rank Evolvers could start to comprehend the space rules, and even then, to fully understand the nine hundred sixty-five space models required at least the Seventh-Rank Marquis Level or even King Level.

But Lin Yuan?

Chikun Star Lord could not understand.

In his long life, he had seen many freaks and monsters, but these were mostly with strong bloodlines or strong physiques, and so on.

Someone like Lin Yuan, who had just joined the Sixth Rank for less than half a year, yet had achieved what usually only those at the Seventh-Rank Marquis or King Level could achieve, was simply too incredible.

“Could it be that my disciple’s talent for space is also strong?” Chikun Star Lord thought distractedly.

For the past five or six thousand years, the most talented in space that Chikun Star Lord had seen was Yin Ling, the silver-haired woman from the last Seven Stars Cave trial.

Chikun Star Lord had even specially awarded her the Red Mark status and opened the Seven Stars Cave Trial World for her.

However, Yin Ling’s talent for space, compared to Lin Yuan, was simply like dog shit.

“Teacher?”

Lin Yuan saw Chikun Star Lord staring at the space model in front of him and spoke softly.

“Mm… I was just reminded of something else…”

Chikun Star Lord immediately reacted and said gravely.

With Chikun Star Lord’s strength, expounding on the superficial nine hundred plus models of the space rules was something he had long since comprehended.

But when Chikun Star Lord had comprehended these nine hundred plus models back in the day, he too was about to step into the Seventh Rank, and this was under the circumstance where his original form was a Starry Sky Wanderer Kun, inherently aligned with the space rules.

If not for confirming that Lin Yuan was indeed of the Human race, Chikun Star Lord would feel that the other resembled a Starry Sky Wanderer Kun even more than himself.

“The eight hundred seventy-sixth space model…”

Chikun Star Lord also raised his hand, manipulating the power of space, and formed a strangely shaped model in front of him.

The model was not fixed, but was slowly changing with the space fluctuations.

“The eight hundred seventy-sixth space model…”

Lin Yuan immediately observed intently. Within the Red Kun Lineage’s cultivation treasury, there was a detailed explanation on the nine hundred sixty-five space models.

There were even specific space-class Evolvers who voluntarily demonstrated the models.

However, space is changing every moment, always fluctuating, and past space models might not be applicable to current space fluctuations.

Thus, the space model Chikun Star Lord currently condensed belonged to the model most attuned to the present universal space rules, naturally providing greater inspiration to Lin Yuan.

[Your understanding defies heaven, observing unknown space models deepens your comprehension of space rules…]

…

[Your understanding defies heaven, observing unknown space models deepens your comprehension of space rules…]

…

[Your understanding defies heaven, observing unknown space models deepens your comprehension of space rules…]

….

Lin Yuan’s mind was bursting with spiritual light, countless insights about the power of space, which he had accumulated during the decades of wandering outside the Central Earth World, watching the chaos of the void, all erupted forth.

Hum…

In front of Lin Yuan.

Hundreds of space models simultaneously collapsed.

Threads of space power rapidly intertwined and collided.

They actually formed a new space model.

This space model, slowly changing with the space fluctuations, turned out to be consistent with the space model in front of Chikun Star Lord.

“So that’s how it is…”

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.

This kind of space model had puzzled Lin Yuan for nearly a month.

Now, with Chikun Star Lord’s guidance, he finally comprehended it thoroughly.

“You figured it out just like that?”

Above the high seat, Chikun Star Lord was dumbfounded.

He had only demonstrated once, and Lin Yuan had learned it?

Chikun Star Lord had just been about to explain a few things, such as reminders for Lin Yuan about how to begin comprehending this type of model.

But the result…

It was as if a teacher was explaining a problem in class.

He had just written out the answer, ready to explain the process and thinking behind it.

However, the students below had already learned it, even extrapolating from it.

“Thank you, teacher.”

Lin Yuan was in a good mood and immediately thanked Chikun Star Lord.

If not for Chikun Star Lord, with his against-heaven’s understanding, Lin Yuan would have ultimately comprehended it, but it definitely would have taken much more time.

“It’s no trouble at all…”

Chikun Star Lord waved his hand.

Logically, the gratitude from a genius like Lin Yuan should have made him feel quite accomplished.

But Chikun Star Lord didn’t know why he felt somewhat off.

He always felt that something was wrong.

“Teacher… could you demonstrate the remaining one hundred space models?”

Lin Yuan seemed to have remembered something and asked a bit sheepishly.

“Demonstrate them all together?”

Chikun Star Lord was silent for a while, unable to help asking.

The nine hundred sixty-five space models, involving the essence of space rules, each model required Evolvers to expend great costs and effort to comprehend.
